name: Settlement Obligation 10
definition: Provides details about the settlement obligation.

RelatedSettlementObligationIdentificatio.name: Related Settlement Obligation Identification
RelatedSettlementObligationIdentificatio.definition: Provides the identification of an existing obligation that is linked to the new obligation.

ObligationType.name: Obligation Type
ObligationType.definition: Indicates the type of the obligation.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Provides additional information related to the linked obligation.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies the quantity related to the settlement obligation.

NetPositionPrice.name: Net Position Price
NetPositionPrice.definition: Provides the price applied to that net position.

TradingCurrency.name: Trading Currency
TradingCurrency.definition: Specifies the ISO code of the trade currency.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Provides the total amount to be settled.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Indicates if the obligation will result in a receive or a delivery of securities.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled.

References.name: References
References.definition: Provides the references of the underlying trade leg(s) and/or the reference to the related net position message.
